reviews.text: 思ったより発色濃いめ？ふわふわしたムースみたいな質感
reviews.zh: 比起想像中顯色度偏高？質地似軟綿綿嘅慕絲

reviews.text: beautiful bold colour and very powdery look i will buy other colours i love how smooth and moisturising it is and doesn't dry your lips.
reviews.zh: 顏色鮮明又夠濃，望落好粉霧。我會買其他色號。佢好滑又保濕，唔會令嘴唇變乾，我好鍾意。

reviews.text: surprisingly smooth and blurry on the lips. it also has a light plumping/cooling feeling that keeps ur lips from feeling wrinkled. it smells very nice. it is able to be layered very lightly without heaviness. quite longlasting and somewhat similar to peripera's over blurring tint but i find this one a bit more moisturising
reviews.zh: 出奇地滑同埋有模糊唇紋嘅效果。仲有少少豐唇同涼浸浸嘅感覺，搞到嘴唇唔會有皺紋感。味道好聞。可以好薄咁逐層疊加，唔會有厚重感。幾持久，同 peripera 嘅 over blurring tint 有少似，但呢隻我覺得再保濕啲。

reviews.text: This is such a good matte lip tint that isn't really Matt on the skin. It feels smooth and velvety and plumping feeling make it so nice to use. It lasts very well also! Colors are so cute! Idk why it isn't viral yet
reviews.zh: 呢隻霧面唇釉好好用，但搽上皮膚其實唔算真係霧面。質地滑又有絲絨感，仲有豐唇感，用落好舒服。持久度都好高！色號好可愛！唔知點解仲未爆紅。

reviews.text: This tint gives you a nice and soft blurring effect. I found it easy to apply and not drying. Such a rich berry color that lasts.
reviews.zh: 呢隻唇釉有好好又溫和嘅模糊效果。我覺得好易推開，唔會乾。Berry 色調好濃郁又持久。

reviews.text: Wow. I usually don't love velvet tints but this one is actually nice and moistureful, not dry. The remover is also working perfectly.
reviews.zh: 嘩。我平時唔太鍾意絲絨唇釉，但呢隻真係幾好又夠保濕，唔會乾。卸妝效果都好完美。

reviews.text: I loved the Amuse Chou Velvet Tint (I used it almost daily) but unfortunately they have discontinued it. After trying the Powder Velvet Tint as a replacement, I did like it but don't think it's quite as good. It does last and the colour/pigment is pretty however, it is patchy and requires a couple of layers.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 Amuse Chou Velvet Tint（我幾乎日日用），但可惜已經停產。試咗 Powder Velvet Tint 嚟代替，我係鍾意嘅，但就唔覺得夠好。佢確實持久，顏色同顯色度都幾靚，不過就會有斑駁，需要疊幾層。

reviews.text: Initially when I tried to apply it it was thick and hard to distribute but once it is distributed evenly on the lips it felt soft and velvety, the color was bright and had no smusges but after eating my lunch you can see it leaves natural nice color seems like a lip liner
reviews.zh: 一開始我試緊搽嘅時候覺得好厚好難推開，但係均勻推開之後就變得軟綿綿又有絲絨感，顏色鮮明又冇暈染，但食完午餐之後就會留低自然又靚嘅顏色，望落好似唇線筆咁。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
